blockers.description: Push to main is blocked by a repository ruleset. Every change — including docs-only — must land via PR + squash merge.
blockers.workaround: gh pr create ... && gh pr merge N --squash --delete-branch

blockers.description: Worktree isolation auto-degrades (worktree.base-check returns shouldDegrade: fork-ref-unknown). Execution is sequential on the main working tree: no worktrees, no git stash.
blockers.workaround: Run waves sequentially; pin wave-1 plan ordering explicitly.
